title: Introduce stochastic subsample prober with dynamic thresholds and diagnostic hints
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: long-running full-eval sweeps are costly and brittle for large prompt catalogs. This PR adds a lightweight stochastic subsample prober that runs as a CI hook, uses adaptive thresholding based on short-window variance, and surfaces compact diagnostic hints when a regression signal is detected. Summary: - New prober module that randomly samples prompts with stratified weights derived from recent traffic and evaluation history. - Dynamic thresholds compute per-metric cutoffs using exponential moving variance and a configurable sensitivity multiplier. - Diagnostic hints collect minimal exemplar pairs and token-level diffs to accelerate triage. - CI integration: a fast-check job that runs in parallel to full-evals; it can soft-fail (annotate) or hard-fail depending on label and linked linear task. Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Lightweight integration test with CI smoke workflow - [x] Docs: README and config reference - [x] Linear links and rollout note included Commits: Initial commit with core sampler and scheduler; add dynamic-threshold math with tests; integrate into ci/jobs/fast-eval.yml and add doc page. Changed files (high level): eval-harness/probes/stochastic_subsample_prober.py (new core logic), eval-harness/eval/thresholds.py (threshold helpers), eval-harness/ci/fast-eval.yml (CI hook), eval-harness/docs/subsample-prober.md (usage), eval-harness/tests/test_subsample_prober.py, eval-harness/tests/test_thresholds.py, eval-harness/utils/diagnostics.py (compact hint formatting). Testing: unit tests added and run locally; CI passed on primary matrix. Rollout: enabled by default on non-blocking mode; ops can flip to blocking by adding label "block-on-fast-eval" on release branches. Linear: ENG-5342 (primary), ENG-5401 (follow-up automation for reruns). Notes: this PR intentionally prioritizes low-cost signals over exhaustive coverage; it is meant as an early-warning layer to catch high-signal regressions before full-eval runs complete.
release_notes: Add a low-cost stochastic subsample prober CI hook that provides early-warning regressions with diagnostic hints. Configurable sensitivity; non-blocking by default.

review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Can you explain how sampling weights are derived from traffic? Response: weights are a weighted blend of recent request frequency (last 7 days) and recent failure score; implementation detail in stratify() with configurable alpha.

Priya Nair: Threshold tuning knobs look sensitive; any safe defaults? Response: default sensitivity multiplier is 1.5 which preserves historical false-positive rate < 1% on past month of runs; doc includes guidance to increase when signal noisiness grows.

Samir Gupta: CI run time concerns — what is expected added latency? Response: fast-eval uses 50 stratified samples per shard with a 10m timeout; added runtime per CI matrix is ~6 minutes median. We also added caching of tokenized prompts to reduce repeat cost.
Diego Ramirez (follow-up): please add telemetry tags so we can filter fast-eval reports by pr_id and run_id. Response: telemetry tags added in diagnostics and events payload (pr_id/run_id/seed).
notes: Post-merge: follow-up task ENG-5401 will wire automatic rerun/backfill for prober failures and add a lightweight dashboard. Ops can toggle enforcement by adding/removing the 'block-on-fast-eval' label per branch.
